purpose: Captain (Navi) position at the start of the day-2 direct-boot session, per starting area, in world x/z. scripts/p2_smoke_seed.py --near-start measures slot distance from here, not from the map origin. The stage .ini navi_start is 0,0 for every stage; the real start is NaviStartingState::init (ufo position + 50 units along the ufo facing), so it is measured, not read from the ini.
source: Measured 2026-09-30 headless on nectar.exe (native-king-eat-build) with PIKMIN_RANDOMIZER_TEST_BACKGROUND=1 PIKMIN_RANDOMIZER_AUTOPLAY=1 on plain seeds m-<area> (generate --starting-area <area>); first AUTOPLAY_NAVI line of native.log (bot at rest, stick=(0,0)). Re-measure with scripts/p2_smoke_seed.py --measure-start AREA.
